content.short: Multi-currency business account and cross-border payments.
content.description: Payset is a UK-based financial platform offering multi-currency business accounts and cross-border payments for internationally active companies. Regulated as an electronic money institution, it lets businesses hold and manage more than 30 currencies, open dedicated IBANs, collect and send international payments, and access competitive foreign exchange, all from a single dashboard. Payset targets startups, e-commerce sellers, agencies, and SMEs that trade across markets and need to receive, convert, and pay in multiple currencies without maintaining separate bank accounts in each country. By consolidating multi-currency accounts, FX, and global payments, Payset helps businesses reduce costs and friction on international transactions while keeping collections, payouts, and reconciliation organized in one place.
content.meta: Payset offers multi-currency business accounts, FX, and cross-border payments. Discover Payset and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
